Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners. Business Transformation & Strategic Initiatives Lead cross-functional transformation programs aimed at improving operational efficiency and business performance. Resolve project conflicts involving scope, budgets, timelines, and resource allocation. Provide executive-level updates on project performance, delivery challenges, and strategic recommendations. Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure successful project execution. Leadership & Team Development Lead project directors, program managers, project managers, and PMO professionals. Develop high-performing project delivery teams across multiple business units. Establish accountability, performance standards, and professional development programs. Promote a culture of project ownership, collaboration, innovation, and delivery excellence. Introduce project management tools, dashboards, and performance measurement systems. 3. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Finance, Business Strategy, or a relevant discipline preferred. 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation. At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership position overseeing complex project portfolios and strategic programs. Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred. Proven track record of delivering large-scale, multi-departmental projects within approved budgets and timelines. Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments. Return on investment (ROI) and realization of expected business benefits. Successful delivery of insurance and investment transformation initiatives. Project risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness. PMO governance and reporting compliance. Resource utilization and project team productivity. Stakeholder satisfaction and project quality ratings. Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks. Successful execution of digital transformation and business expansion projects.
